name: oauth2-oidc-jwt-security-hardening-auditor
title: OAuth2 / OIDC & JWT Security Hardening Auditor
description: Audit OAuth2/OIDC and JWT verification configs for alg=none confusion, disabled aud/iss/exp/signature checks, hardcoded signing secrets or private JWKs, implicit/no-PKCE grants, wildcard redirect_uri, and insecure localStorage token persistence or long TTLs.
